about: Generations of the Fig. 12 rides computed on Kaggle, newest last. The page plays the newest; older ones are kept for the record.

generations.note: over-damped (damping ratio 0.10 to 0.14 after the last bump): glass faces held at zero velocity, a no-slip wall one cell thick; kept for the record, with the free-swing tests of solver v2
Taichi: ghost-fluid surface, free-slip glass faces, the Fig. 12 note's wall and foam friction; played by the page until 13 November 2026, evening; kept for the record

runs.what: the three rides with the speed held only, and the free swings with and without the head
the same roads with the site's controllers in the loop: joint control on all three, slosh LQR and road preview on the kerb

generations.note: JAX (tools/fig12/kaggle/stout_jax.py): APIC particles on a 1.5 mm grid, the head of foam as a sheet with its weight, yield stress and wall friction, the cart and its controllers coupled both ways; played by the page
